let x: string | undefined = "a";
class K { static { console.log(x.length); } }
const K2 = class { static { console.log(x.length); } };
class K3 { static n = 1; static { K3.n = x.length; } }
let y: string | undefined = "b";
class K4 { static { y = undefined; } }
console.log(y.length);
let z: string | undefined;
class K5 { static { if (z) console.log(z.length); console.log(this.name); } }
class K6 { static s = x.length; }
let w: string | undefined = "c";
function later() { return w.length; }
class K7 { static { console.log(w.length); } m() { return w.length; } }
console.log(K, K2, K3, K4, K5, K6, later, K7);
